gloss: on the board; on the game board

definitions.gloss: on the board; on the game board; the board (as a playing field)
definitions.explanation: Refers to the surface of a game board in chess, shogi, go, or similar board games. Used both literally (the physical board) and figuratively (the strategic situation in a game).

examples.japanese: {盤上|ばんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駒|こま}→駒：07119_koma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
examples.english: To move a piece on the board.

examples.japanese: {盤上|ばんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形勢|けいせい}→形勢：16342_keisei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧だ。
examples.english: The position on the board favors white.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦{棋士|きし}→棋士：27809_kishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盤上|ばんじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何十手|なんじゅって}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Professional shogi players can read dozens of moves ahead on the board.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (board, as in ⟦{碁盤|ごばん}→碁盤：13716_goban⟧ or ⟦{将棋盤|しょうぎばん}→将棋盤：24835_shougiban⟧) and ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (on, above). Primarily used in the context of board games — especially ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ (shogi) and ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧ (go) — but also applicable to chess and other tabletop strategy games.

In Japanese culture, shogi and go have deep traditions, and {盤上|ばんじょう} carries a sense of intellectual battle and strategic depth. The phrase {盤上|ばんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧ (a contest on the board) can also be used metaphorically for any cerebral competition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盤上|ばんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧: a match on the board; a battle of wits
- {盤上|ばんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形勢|けいせい}→形勢：16342_keisei⟧: the position/situation on the board
- {盤上|ばんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支配|しはい}する→支配する：25222_shihaisuru⟧: to dominate the board
- {盤上|ばんじょう}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: board game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{碁盤|ごばん}→碁盤：13716_goban⟧: go board — the physical board itself
- ⟦{将棋盤|しょうぎばん}→将棋盤：24835_shougiban⟧: shogi board — the physical board itself
- ⟦{局面|きょくめん}→局面：05777_kyokumen⟧: game position; phase — the state of play at a given moment
